Isinyathelo 3: Ukubala kunikeza u-$V = 4.90\text{ L}$.

Isixazululo se-asidi $A$ sinokusansimbi $[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-3}\text{ M}$ kanti isixazululo $B$ sino-$[\text{H}^+] = 1.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ M}$. Kaphindwe kangaki ukugcwala kwe-ion ye-hydrogen ku-$A$ kukhulu kune-B?

20261121-chemistry-g03-1.s.s1.explain:
Isinyathelo 1: $[\text{H}^+]_A = 10^{-3}\text{ M}$, $[\text{H}^+]_B = 10^{-5}\text{ M}$.
Isinyathelo 2: Isilinganiso $\frac{1.0 \times 10^{-3}}{1.0 \times 10^{-5}} = 10^2 = 100$.
